This confirms it exactly. This commit (`8957b2666cf7a44f37b6421057556a4ff37fba9d`) added the "Teaching Responsibility" feature, which increased the `WebTable( 5, ... )` to `WebTable( 6, ... )` and added `MSG.columnTeachingResponsibility()` to the header string array and `responsibility` to the data row — but failed to update the alignment array `new String[] {"left", "left","left", "left", "left"}` from 5 to 6 elements. The fix commit `22e31621` simply appends the missing `"left"` to match.

## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: 8957b2666cf7a44f37b6421057556a4ff37fba9d

## Reasoning

**(1) Investigation:** I ran `git log --follow -p` on `InstructorDetailAction.java` to trace the full history of the `WebTable(5, ...)` block referenced in the fix diff, looking for the commit where the number of columns (header array) diverged from the alignment array (`"left"` strings) without updating both in sync.

**(2) Specific change:** In commit `8957b2666c`, the "Teaching Responsibilities" feature was added. It changed `new WebTable(5, ...)` to `new WebTable(6, ...)`, added `MSG.columnTeachingResponsibility()` to the header `String[]`, and added a `responsibility` field to the data row — but the parallel alignment array (`new String[] {"left", "left","left", "left", "left"}`) was left at 5 elements instead of being extended to 6. This is a classic "shotgun surgery miss": three parallel arrays/structures needed to be updated together (column count, header labels, alignment, row data) and one was forgotten.

**(3) Evidence:** The fix commit `22e31621` diff only appends one `"left"` to that exact array at the exact same line, changing nothing else — it's a pure counter-fix to the omission. Tracing back through `git log -p`, commit `8957b2666c` is the only commit that touches this specific `WebTable(5...)`/`WebTable(6...)` branch and introduces the `MSG.columnTeachingResponsibility()` column while leaving the alignment array unchanged at its old length. All prior history of this file shows the header array and alignment array sizes staying in sync until this commit.

I'm confident in this identification — the diff is a direct, isolated match for the omitted update.
